title: Klarna brings flexible payments to Fresha, backing small businesses globally | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**London, November 2, 2026** – Klarna, the everyday finance network, is partnering with Fresha, the leading booking platform for beauty and wellness, to bring payment choice to selfcare and help tens of thousands of small- and medium-sized businesses worldwide look after their clients.


The beauty and wellbeing sector is built on corner stores – in the UK, where Fresha is headquartered, more than 60,000 hair and beauty firms employ fewer than five people – and a quiet day or a last-minute cancellation can hurt. By bringing salons simpler, more flexible ways to pay, including by interest-free instalments, Klarna and Fresha are making it easier for consumers to stay healthy, while empowering providers to focus on their craft rather than their cash flow.


The partnership highlights Klarna's quickening expansion beyond retail and into services, deepening its presence in beauty and wellness from products on the shelf to in-person appointments — one of the fastest-growing corners of the experience economy.


"Independent salons and barbershops deserve the same smart payment tools as the biggest retailers," said Klarna Country Manager UK & Ireland Marc O'Fathaigh. "By making Klarna a direct option on Fresha, we're giving thousands of small businesses globally a smarter way to grow, and their clients a fairer way to pay."


“Our partnership with Klarna gives more people the flexibility to book the beauty and wellness treatments that help them feel their best,” said Annabelle Taurua, Beauty Expert at Fresha. ”By offering greater choice at checkout, we’re opening the door for a wider audience to prioritise themselves while supporting the independent businesses at the heart of our communities.”


Klarna is available now as an option for Fresha merchants globally, offering consumers the ability to spread the cost interest-free in instalments at providers including hair, beauty, barbering, nails, aesthetics, wellness, fitness, and spa.


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](https://www.klarna.com/)


.


**About Fresha**
Fresha is the world’s leading AI-powered booking platform for beauty and wellness, trusted by over 130,000 partner businesses across more than 120 countries. Its fully integrated ecosystem spans scheduling, payments, marketing, team management, and a global consumer marketplace, giving beauty and wellness businesses everything they need to operate, grow, and scale. The Fresha Marketplace connects millions of consumers with salons, spas, barbershops, and wellness studios worldwide, with over one million monthly downloads and more than $1.4 billion in monthly transaction value. To learn more, visit


[fresha.com](http://fresha.com/)


.
